name: Minase Emi
source:
A newly hired teacher at an all boys school. She teaches Modern Japanese.

She was attracted to a dependable [url=/c114411]Hayasaka Minoru[/url] when she was a teacher trainee so she confessed to him. 

Because of her gentle and somewhat unreliable demeanor, she trusts people easily and is easily deceived too.

They have dates every week, and always have sex right after. She has no complaint with her night life. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/098/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
